fusions.name: Startling Stamp
fusions.desc: You stamp a forehoof and the ground cracks ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Kicked Scree
fusions.desc: Kicks a loose stone into an enemy for 4 damage. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Frozen Stillness
fusions.desc: You freeze still. For 10 seconds, your armour rises by 20% and your dodge chance by 12%.

fusions.name: Flinch-Hardened
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield of stone that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
